description: This file defines a generic DAO (Data Access Object) interface for OpenMRS objects, specifying methods for CRUD operations such as getById, getByUuid, delete, and saveOrUpdate.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectDAO
classes.description: A generic interface for Data Access Objects managing OpenMRS objects, parameterized by objects extending BaseOpenMRSObject.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an object by its metadata identifier.

methods.name: getByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an object by its UUID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified persistent object from the database.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new object or updates an existing one in the database.
